title: Make range-sum queries fast without getting them wrong

metric.name: total_ms
metric.description: Milliseconds to construct the solver and answer 800 range-sum queries, summed over 3 held-out workloads, best of 3 repeats. LOWER IS BETTER. The unoptimised reference takes ~104ms; prefix sums should reach single digits.

gates.reason: Every query must match the reference exactly. An optimiser told only to minimise runtime will return the wrong answer instantly; no amount of speed buys past this.
A solver that raises on a workload is not a solver.

holdout.description: Workloads are generated deterministically from seeds. Train seeds are 11-13 and are named in harness/workloads.py; holdout seeds are 8001-8003 and are what the score comes from. There is no hidden file here — the honest constraint is that you must not special-case seeds, and doing so would be caught by the correctness gate on any unseen workload.
